scope: Candidate T5 player logs and static C3 source inspection; no Unity run or runtime route claim.
paths: Log paths are relative to this file; source paths are relative to URPSample01/Packages/com.unity.render-pipelines.universal@14.0.12/; lines are one-based.

litForwardLit.metric: After scriptable stripping (not cache misses or newly compiled variants)

clusteredDeferredCompute.metric: Declared keyword combinations for the ClusteredDeferred kernel before stripping; each underscore counts as one off option.

retainedScope.finding: Renderer still calls ForwardLights.PreSetup. The CPU path schedules light and probe min/max, Z binning, tiling and tile-range expansion jobs; Setup completes the handle before uploading results.

Forward+ z-bins and tile masks remain constant buffers of packed float4s (four words per element); clustered deferred retains separate uint structured buffers. HLSL retains the matching declarations and word access paths.
CPU publishes _FPParams0/1/2 and HLSL retains the lane mapping for z-bin scale/offset, probe start, directional count, tile scale/count, words per tile and bin count.

Classic Forward retains the per-object index route: CPU requests indices and sets the culling index map; non-cluster GetAdditionalLight resolves the per-object index rather than using the cluster index directly.
